headline: From 25 to 660,000: How One Kenyan Changed School Meals
meta_description: Wawira Njiru's Food4Education programme now serves over 660,000 children daily in Kenya, having distributed 200 million meals.
summary_short: What began as one woman feeding 25 children in her Kenyan hometown has grown into a daily meal programme reaching more than 660,000 students.
body:
Wawira Njiru started with 25 hungry children in her Kenyan hometown. Today, her Food4Education programme provides meals to more than 660,000 children every single day.

The scale of impact tells its own story: the programme has served over 200 million meals since its inception. What began as a grassroots effort has transformed into a nationwide initiative, quietly reshaping access to nutrition and education across Kenya.

At just 21 years old when she started, Njiru recognised a simple truth—that hungry children cannot learn. By addressing that barrier directly, she created a model that sustains both bodies and futures. Her work demonstrates how one person's commitment to their community, matched with determination and vision, can ripple outward to touch hundreds of thousands of lives.
